g.text: audio-in-adc: 2 x audio in -> inverting op-amp on +5 V (gain -0.3, biased to 2.5 V) -> 1k/1nF, 2.2 uF -> audio ADC

g.desc: audio-in-adc: 2 x audio in -> inverting op-amp on +5 V (gain -0.3, biased to 2.5 V) -> 1k/1nF, 2.2 uF -> audio ADC

g.text: audio ADC slave (MD1 = MD0 = low), I2S (FMT low), 24 bits in 32-bit frames: SCKI 256 fs, BCK and LRCK from the MCU.

g.desc: audio ADC slave (MD1 = MD0 = low), I2S (FMT low), 24 bits in 32-bit frames: SCKI 256 fs, BCK and LRCK from the MCU.

g.text: Panel: J1 IN L, J2 IN R = JST PH to jack (1 tip, 2 GND). IN_L / IN_R: on-board inputs summing with the jacks.

g.desc: Panel: J1 IN L, J2 IN R = JST PH to jack (1 tip, 2 GND). IN_L / IN_R: on-board inputs summing with the jacks.

g.text: +-5 V at the jack = the ADC's 3 Vpp full scale. The stage cannot leave 0..5 V: no clamp needed at VIN.

g.desc: +-5 V at the jack = the ADC's 3 Vpp full scale. The stage cannot leave 0..5 V: no clamp needed at VIN.
